set.request: cms/edit drafts via page.store() + colstyles fourth look (Glass, if it earns its place)
steps: read prior art: page.store(), colstyles decisions
cms/edit: wire draft store + visible note/discard
colstyles: build Glass look (depth-based alpha ladder)
colstyles: measure body-text contrast, both schemes
set.outcome:
**Both S items shipped.** cms/edit drafts now survive a reload via `page.store()` — typed text patches the store on a 400ms debounce, a quiet "draft · restored" note + Discard button appear once one is restored, Save/Discard both clear it; proved headless (type → reload → text + note back → discard → reload → gone). Colstyles ships a fourth look, Glass — depth read off the alpha ladder (`--fill-a04` behind you, `--fill-a08` in the pane you're in) via a structural `:has(~ .page-column-pages .page-column-body)` selector, `backdrop-filter` earning its one placement on the sticky head. First attempt used `.active-page`/`.active-ancestor` and silently painted every column identically — `demo.app()` has no Router (its own doc says so) — a headless probe caught it before a screenshot would have. Contrast on body text, both schemes: light 7.90–8.59:1, dark 11.66–13.05:1 — well over the 4.5:1 floor. Zero new console errors at 400/1920/3440 (one pre-existing, unrelated 404 for `welcome/page.js`, present before this task and outside the fence).

**Pages:** [cms/edit](/imagine/cms/edit/) · [Colstyles — four looks](/imagine/vary/colstyles/) · [Glass](/imagine/vary/colstyles/glass/)
**Docs:** `cms/edit/readme.md` + `doc/decisions.md` (new) · `colstyles/readme.md` + `doc/decisions.md` (Glass entry, with the router trap and the contrast table)
**Left, outside the fence:** `cms/readme.md`'s "in core since 2026-08-31" line (parent dir, not `edit/**`) and `vary/readme.md`'s "Three labs" line — both stale now, flagged for whoever's fence includes them next.
